summary: This paper presents a definitive, fully verified mathematical and physical framework establishing complete scalar resolvent characterization, closed-form qutrit boundaries, and quantum-coherence advantage beyond Blackwell majorization in quantum-state texture. Using 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems with zero unproven sorries or non-constructive choice axioms, alongside an independent zero-float Python verifier, the authors rigorously prove resolvent monotonicity, exact concavity, Sherman-Morrison spectral identity equivalence, and qutrit state-space convertibility boundaries. The work bridges information geometry and quantum resource theory with absolute mathematical rigor.
